latest.title: AWS CloudShell Has a Hidden API. Here's How to Use It with boto3.
latest.description:
Did you know AWS CloudShell has a full REST API behind the scenes? 

I built an unofficial boto3 client that lets you programmatically create environments (including VPC mode), open interactive sessions, transfer files, and manage the full lifecycle — with native retries and error handling.

Think: bastion-less VPC access, disposable test environments, automation — all without spinning up EC2. 👌

latest.title: AWS PrivateLink Proof of Concept (POC) - Basic Setup
latest.description: A month ago we started a new project for one of our customers along with a vendor providing a certain tool to be used for BI reports. The BI reports were dependent on the RDS database on our AWS account, but the vendor was hosting the tool on their account. By all means, we cannot provide them with any access to our AWS account, the only access to be provided is for the RDS database, and only RDS. That is why we thought of using AWS PrivateLink!

trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query.
